You will be working closely with the Infrastructure Expert and other technical teams to deliver infrastructure changes, troubleshoot and resolve incidents, maintain service reliability and continual service improvements of the DIH infrastructure environment. Proactivity and analytical mindset are key in your role to identify the recurring issues, detect any anomaly, alerts or capacity issue and take the ownership end-to-end ensuring the infrastructure resilience and reliability. Maintaining the infrastructure documentations, standard procedures and knowledge articles is very crucial to operate and for audit purposes. You will ensure that all activities are performed in accordance with the approved policies, standards and controls. Your communication skills are key to this role in be able to provide the best User Experience to our End Users. Professional experience in enterprise network and infrastructure administration and operations. Experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls and SD-WAN including configuration, patching, upgrade, troubleshooting and lifecycle management. Strong knowledge and practical experience with Cisco technologies in routing and switching. Solid understanding of network security, segmentation, VPN and high availability and resilient network. Manage Microsoft Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP and related enterprise services. Hands-on experience in troubleshooting problems in a complex environment and drive them through resolution. Cisco and Palo Alto certifications English language fluency. Desirables Experience in network automation, scripting and infrastructure as a code. Exposure to cloud networking and hybrid-cloud environments. Experience in Windows server and Linux administration. Understanding of virtualization technology such as VMWare or Hyper-V. ITIL foundation certified Connect to your business – Technology & Transformation Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, and collaborative working. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact that matters. Personal Independence Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm. The recruitment team will provide further details as you progress through the recruitment process. Connect with your colleagues Location: Cairo, Egypt “What attracted me to Deloitte were the endless opportunities and the collective experience of other like-minded individuals. Deloitte’s clients include many of the world’s largest organizations; I wanted to be part of a team that made a difference that I could be proud of.” -Dan, Technology & Transformation “Everyone always says “it’s the people,” and that’s true. Working for a brand you feel proud of feels pretty good too. And you don’t have any stress about fitting into a particular stereotype, because there are so many different types of people in Deloitte Digital.” – Gillian, Technology & Transformation Our commitment to you Making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So, we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before. We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective, and personality. So, we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for. Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead. Connect to your next step A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.
